final: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) as line_item_count, SUM(derived_product_cost) / SUM(derived_total_cost) as cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT ir.invoice_number, ir.cost_ratio, ir.line_item_count, ir.cost_ratio / ar.avg_ratio as relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios ir, average_ratio ar WHERE ar.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL ASC, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
